text: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，到2030年，煤炭兜底保障能力进一步增强，生产开发布局持续优化，优质先进产能比重进一步提升，产供储销体系更加完善，全国大型现代化煤矿产能比重提升至87%；安全绿色开发和清洁高效利用水平明显提高，全系统智能化建设深入推进，智能化煤矿产能比例提升至75%；煤基多元化产业格局加快形成，煤炭消费实现达峰，供需动态平衡保障机制进一步健全，行业现代化治理能力显著提高，现代煤炭产业体系基本建成，煤炭高质量发展迈上新台阶。
text_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development.' It states that by 2030, coal's role as a safety net will be further strengthened, production and development layout continuously optimized, the share of quality advanced capacity further increased, and the production-supply-storage-sales system more complete, with the share of large modern coal mines rising to 87%. Safe green development and clean efficient utilization levels will improve markedly, with full-system intelligent construction advanced and the share of intelligent coal mine capacity rising to 75%. A coal-based diversified industrial pattern will take shape faster, coal consumption will peak, the dynamic supply-demand balance guarantee mechanism will be further improved, industry modernization governance capacity notably enhanced, a modern coal industry system basically established, and high-quality coal development taken to a new level.
